recorded: 2026-10-12, before any capacity run, on the owner's instruction. They are not derived from any capacity measurement and are not to be widened after results are seen: a change is recorded as a change, with the reason.
heavy: success and refusals are reported separately, by kind, in every phase and every repeat. There is no pass or fail threshold on heavy success; heavy p99 is judged.
min_samples_note: A success rate or a p99 is judged only when the class has at least this many requests in the phase. Fewer is reported as UNJUDGED with the count, and an unjudged class cannot make a rate pass. The short ladder cannot judge medium or heavy at low rates, which is why it only locates the knee. Only a longer confirmation run at the candidate rate, with every class at or above the minimum, can establish 'sustainable'.

unchanged.memory_plateau: the API's anonymous memory after the last repeat is within 10 percent of the first
unchanged.recovery: 30 s after the load stops the admission queues are empty
